failed_login_spike.title: Failed Login Spike
failed_login_spike.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('LOGIN','LOGON') and 'Operation Status' = 'FAILURE' | stats count as DetectionCount

privilege_change.title: Privilege or Entitlement Change
privilege_change.description: Database grants, revocations, or role changes.
privilege_change.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('GRANT','REVOKE','CREATE ROLE','ALTER ROLE','DROP ROLE') | stats count as DetectionCount

audit_control_change.title: Audit Control Change
audit_control_change.description: Changes to audit policies or audit configuration.
audit_control_change.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and ('Operation' like '*AUDIT*' or 'Object Type' like '*AUDIT*') | stats count as DetectionCount

sql_firewall_violation.title: SQL Firewall Violation
sql_firewall_violation.description: SQL activity rejected or reported by SQL Firewall.
sql_firewall_violation.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and ('Event Name' like '*FIREWALL*' or 'Action Taken' like '*BLOCK*') | stats count as DetectionCount

sensitive_data_access.title: Sensitive Data Access
sensitive_data_access.description: Activity classified by Data Safe as sensitive.
sensitive_data_access.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Sensitive Activity' = 1 | stats count as DetectionCount

data_extraction_spike.title: Data Extraction Spike
data_extraction_spike.description: High SELECT or export activity in one detection interval.
data_extraction_spike.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('SELECT','EXPORT') | stats count as DetectionCount

database_error_spike.title: Database Error Spike
database_error_spike.description: Elevated failed operations or database errors.
database_error_spike.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation Status' = 'FAILURE' | stats count as DetectionCount

off_hours_admin_activity.title: Administrative Activity
off_hours_admin_activity.description: Administrative database activity; tune the alarm threshold for the customer's approved baseline.
off_hours_admin_activity.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Admin User' = 1 | stats count as DetectionCount
